# Kit/Pack Costing

# Scope

# Purpose

# Solution

## Kit/Pack Management
When the user accesses the Techpack screen, the availability of Single and Multi-options will be controlled Based on setting and on NEW BOM it will work as specified below.
The Component Type field will be available as a dropdown with the following options:
• Single
• Multi
Based on the user’s selection:
• If Single is selected, a “Pack” tab will be enabled on the header.
• If Multi is selected, a “Kit” tab will be enabled on the header.

## Kit/Pack Tab
Once the user navigates to the Kit/Pack tab:
• The system displays a list of already created Kit/Packs.
• A “Configure Kit/Pack” button will be available at the header level of the grid
Displayed Data in Grid
Each Kit/Pack record will include the following fields:
• Kit ID – Hyperlink that opens View Page of Kit/Pack Details
• Kit Name – Manual Kit/Pack Creation Screen
• Ratio Type - Manual Kit/Pack Creation Screen
• Total Cost – Is same as Total/Consolidated selling price of no. of Articles present inside that Kit/Pack.
• Status – Both status are in sync from Kit/Pack Creation screen.
• Save
• Confirmed
• Created Date – Based on the transaction creation date.
• Last Modified Date – Last date of Modification of Kit/Pack.
• Actions (Context Menu)

## Actions
Each Kit/Pack record provides the following actions via the context menu:

### Edit:
• Can be performed in two ways:
• From the context menu
• From inside the Kit Details screen using the Edit button
• Allows modification of an existing Draft or Active Kit/Pack

### View
• Opens the Kit/Pack Details screen

### Duplicate
• Triggered from: Context Menu → Duplicate
• System shows a confirmation prompt:
• “Duplicate BOM: 1”
• A Kit line will get added.

### Export
• Triggered from: Context Menu → Export: to export the grid details with respective headers.
• System shows a confirmation prompt:
• “Export BOM: 1”

## Kit Details
Users can open the Kit/Pack Details screen in two ways:
• By clicking on Kit ID
• By selecting View from the context menu

### Details Screen Includes
• Kit Information
• Kit Id
• Kit Name
• Ratio Type
• Kit SKU
• BOM Line Items
• Displays all associated BOM components
• Kit Summary – All BOM Lines details. And same representation as given inside Summary Tab.

## Configure Kit/Pack
User had already made Two or more articles for e.g.: Shirt and Trouser with their respective BOM(Manufacturing BOM) , Now when we create a New techpack Name Shirt-Trouser KIT in BOM we are going to select those articles(Shirt and trouser), Now when we configure a techpack all the articles present in the BOM of kit will auto – populated here & and if user want to create a new techpack he can do that with drop down under article and to create New BOM that can also be done from Manufacturing BOM dropdown.
Clicking on “Configure Kit/Pack” opens the Create Kit/Pack screen.
• When the user selects “Single” in the Component Type on the Techpack, the style details will be automatically picked up and populated under the Pack Items (Article) tab.
• When the user selects “Multi”, the designated two or more styles intended to be part of the kit will be automatically picked up and populated under the Kit Items (Article) tab.

## Create Kit/Pack Screen

### Header-Level Actions (Create Kit/Pack Screen)
Available at the top of the screen
1. Copy From (Secondary Button)
• Allows copying data from an existing KIT/PACK.
2. Save Draft (Secondary Button)
• Saves the current configuration
• Shows confirmation:
• “BOM saved successfully”
3. Confirm (Primary Button)
• Generates BOM based on entered data
• Shows confirmation:
• “BOM generated successfully
Note: We need same MRP tool that is present on NEW BOM.

### Kit Details Section:
The user must fill the following fields and this section should work like a collapse and expand. Once it is collapsed then on the banner it should show the following details in view mode only: Packing Kit ID, Packing Kit Name, Component Type and Ratio Type.
• Packing Kit ID (By default Editable)- It can also can be Configure from System Coding.
• Packing Kit Name (Editable)
• Component Type
• Single
• Multi
• Ratio Type (Dropdown)
• Color Ratio – When Component type is Single.
• Size Ratio - When Component type is Single.
• Mixed Ratio - When Component type is Multi.
• Packing Kit SKU (Editable)
• Packing Kit Description (Editable)
Under the Kit Details section, an additional grid is available consisting of multiple tabs and configurations related to Kit Items.

### Kit Items (Articles) Tab
This tab defines the articles/items included in a Kit/Pack BOM.
Functionality
• Displays Kit Articles & Variations.
• Defines how many articles are included in a kit (e.g., 2 T-shirts in one kit)
• Kit Items should work at component level.
Field Details :
• Article – Article should be driven from the add item.
• Color – Multiselect Dropdown based on the selected Article on color card. If multiple color are added than a child row will get added.
• Size – Multiselect Dropdown based on the selected Article on size card. If multiple sizes are added than a child row will get added.
• Quantity – It is editable
• Price – Selling Price of Article
• Manufacturing BOM – Driven from Article techpack (Subsequent BOM)
• Actions – Delete Action.
• All the Columns from the BOM will come as it is
Note: We need a Color and Size level dependency(only Table Dependency) such that Kit ID on backend is mapped with Color and Sizes, selected on the Packing Material Screen.
Kit Id – On Left ---------------------- Article – On Right
When User Selects Color and sizes then child nodes are created and these are mapped in backend with Kit ID, and when user expands the Article then child nodes can be seen as shown in the Screen above.
UI Correction: Price Can be manually edited for child line as well and Manufacturing BOM can only be selected only at parent line.

#### Actions in Kit/Items (Article Tab)

##### Add
• User clicks on “Add Item” (shown in images)
• User can add multiple articles Inside kit(if existing will come directly in dropdown if not then we can create new Article) same for BOM.
• Each article contains:
• Article selection
• Color (Multi-select)
• Size (Multi-select)
• Auto-generated SKU
• Quantity
• Manufacturing BOM selection

##### View BOM – Hyperlink Functionality
A “View & Edit” hyperlink will be provided adjacent to the Manufacturing BOM field.
• On clicking the “View” hyperlink, the system will open the BOM details screen in view mode and user can also edit it when permissions enabled.
• The user will be able to review all BOM line items and related details in a read-only format.

##### Add New Article Functionality (Within Article Dropdown)
Within the Article column dropdown, an option “Add New Article” will be available.
• On clicking “Add New Article,” a right-side panel will be opened.
The panel will contain the following fields:
• Product Group – Dropdown (Single Select)
• Sub-category – Dropdown (Single Select)
• Article Name – Editable Field
• Buyer Style Reference – Editable Field
• Article Code – Editable Field
• Color – Dropdown (Multi-select)
• Size – Dropdown (Multi-select)
At the bottom of the panel, the following actions will be available:
• Cancel
• Save Article
On clicking “Save Article”:
• The article will be saved in the system.
• The newly created article will be available in the Article dropdown list for selection
Behaviour
• Multiple selections of color/size automatically generate combinations (child rows)
• Horizontal scrolling is supported for viewing all fields

##### Delete
Works on line level, and deletes that particular line.

### Packaging Materials Tab
This tab captures materials required for packing the kit (shown in images).
Fields: will be same as present in BOM as Shown in Image below
Note: We need a Color and Size level dependency(only Table Dependency) such that Kit ID on backend is mapped with Color and Sizes, selected on the Packing Material Screen.
Kit Id – On Left ---------------------- Article – On Right
Key Points
• All fields are editable
• Multiple packaging materials can be added
• These will be included as separate line items in the final BOM

### Other Costs Tab
This tab captures additional costs associated with the kit.
Fields
• Charges
• Basis (e.g., Per Kit)
• Currency
• Rate
• Value
• Value (CS Currency)
• Actions (Delete only)
Key Points
• Represents costs like:
• Freight
• Courier
• Handling
• These costs are included in the final BOM calculation

### Routing Processes Tab
This tab defines process flow and mapping (shown in images).
Sub Sections
a. Process - Same as present in Routing -> Process Tab (Shown Below in pic)
• Packing
• Cutting
• Sewing
• Fields:
b. Material Linking
• Links BOM line items to defined processes
Fields – Same as Routing -> Material Linkage Tab
Behaviour
• Default process assignment is Packing
• User can modify process using dropdown

### Summary Tab
This tab provides a complete overview of the Kit/Pack (shown in images).
a. Kit Information
• Kit ID: Auto Populate from Kit Items tab
• Kit Name: Auto Populate
• Ratio Type: Auto Populate
• Kit SKU: Auto Populate
b. BOM Line Items
Displays combined data from:
• Kit Items (Article) will be Parent line- will have feature of expand and collapse
• Material used – Shown as type of BOM detail (Child line)
• Packaging Materials (child line)
• Other Costs (child line)
Fields of Header name– As per BOM as shown below
BOM Line Items – Summary & Expansion Behaviour:
In the BOM Line Items (Summary Section):
• The summary view will populate the following details for the selected style(s)
• On clicking/expanding the style line item:
• The system will display the materials used to construct that style (i.e., underlying BOM components such as fabric, trims, etc.).
• If Kit is configured:
• Multiple styles will be displayed under the Kit Items tab in the summary.
• Each style will support the same expand/collapse functionality, showing its respective material breakdown.
c. Cost Summary
Provides financial breakdown:
• Total Cost – Total Consolidated price of Both the Articles (with Materials included) + Packing Material + Other Costs + Routing Process
• Selling Price – Initially going to be auto-populated, but user can further edit it.
• Discount – As it is currently working in new BOM.
• Profit – Eff SP - TC
• Markup - SP – CP, Markup% -> (Markup Value/CP)* 100
• SMV: Will have the dependency with respective of kit id.
Data will Show Kit item name and SMV used to make that particular item.
• EPM – This comes on the basis of configuration and setting.
Generic Formula:
EPM = (Selling Price- (Material Cost + Import Cost + EMB Process Cost))/SAM
E.g. :- 1.48 =(30-(6.6+4+12))/5
Note: It will work same like New BOM and all the permissions will be applicable here.

## MRP
MRP Level Structure for Kit/Pack
For Kit/Pack configurations, the MRP hierarchy levels will function as follows:
• First Level:
The system will display the Kit/Pack Item information.
• Second Level:
Under the Kit/Pack Item, the system will display the associated Article information.
• Third Level:
Under each Article, the system will display the raw materials/components used to manufacture that Article.
Note: If There is any Sub BOM, recipe or if fabric is achieved from Yarn than those details will come on below levels.
